name: trading-botani
description: Web trading bot multi-bot untuk Indodax + Tokocrypto dengan kontrol Telegram & proxy

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test:live: npm run test:live-mock -w server && npm run test:live-e2e -w server
scripts.test:all: npm run test:live-mock -w server && npm run test:live-e2e -w server && npm run test:killswitch -w server && npm run test:safety -w server && npm run test:features -w server && npm run test:v2 -w server && npm run test:auth -w server && npm run test:backtest -w server && npm run test:telegram -w server && npm run test:balance -w server && npm run test:budget -w server && npm run test:bittime -w server && npm run test:resume -w server && npm run test:audit -w server && npm run test:tgui -w server && npm run test:strat -w server && npm run test:format -w server
